trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا یَا قُرَّتَیْ عَیْنِ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا یَا فَلْذَتَیْ كَبِدِ ابْنِ عَمِّ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا یَا نَاصِرَیْ سِبْطِ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا السَّابِقَانِ فِی الشَّهَادَۃِ مِنْ ذِیْ رَحْمِ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الشَّهِیْدَانِ فِیْ نُصْرَۃِ دِیْنِ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الْمَظْلُوْمَانِ الْقَتِیْلَانِ بِاَرْضِ كَرْبَلَاءِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الْمَظْلُوْمَانِ بِاَیْدِی الْاَشْقِیَآءِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الْمُخَلَّفَانِ مِنْ مُسْلِمِ ابْنِ عَقِیْلٍ اَلْقَتِیْلِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الذَّبِیْحَانِ مِنْ نَسْلِ اِسْمٰعِیْلَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا اَیُّهَا الْحَیَّانِ الْمَرْزُوْقَانِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمَا الْجَلِیْلِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA YAA QURRATAY A'YNE RASOOLIL LAAHE ASSALAMO A'LAYKOMA YAA FALZATAY KABADE IBNE A'MME RASOOLIL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA YAA NAASERAI SIBTE RASOOLIL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAS SAABEQAANE FISH-SHAHAADATE MIN ZEE RAHME RASOOLIL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHASH SHAHEEDANE FEE NUSRATE DEENIL LAAHE. AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAL MAZLOOMANIL QATEELAANE BE ARZE KARBALAA AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAL MAZLOOMAANE BE AYDIL ASHKEYAAE AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAL MOKHALLAFAANE MIN MUSLIM IBNE AQEELIN ALQATEEL ASSALAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAZ ZABEEHAANE MIN NASLE ISMAAE'ELA AS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA AYYOHAL HAYYAANIL MARZOOQAANE I'NDA RABBEKOMAL JALEELE.

trans.en: Salam on both of you, O coolness of the eyes of Rasoolullah! Salam on both of you, O pieces of the heart of the cousin of Rasoolullah! Salam on both of you, O helpers of the grandson of Rasoolullah! Salam on both of you, O those who were preceders amongst the martyrs related to Rasoolullah! Salam on both of you, O those martyred in aiding the religion of Allah! Salam on both of you, O tormented martyrs on the field of Karbala! Salam on both of you, O those who were tortured by the hands of non-believers! Salam on both of you, O son of Muslim Ibne Aqeel Shaheed! Salam on both of you, O those who were sacrificed from the descendants of Ismail! Salam on both of you, O those who continue to live, nurtured by Allah!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكُمَا جَاهَدْتُمَا فِیْ نُصْرَۃِ دِیْنِ اللہِ وَحِمَایَۃِ عِتْرَۃِ رَسُوْلِ اللہِ حَقَّ الْجِهَادِ فَجَزَاكُمَا اللہُ عَنْهُ وَعَنْ نَبِیِّهٖ وَاَهْلِ بَیْتِهٖ وَعَنِ الْاِسْلَامِ وَاَهْلِهٖ اَفْضَلَ جَزَآءِ الشُّهَدَآءِ وَاَنْمٰی حُظُوْظِ السُّعَدَآءِ وَاَرْفَعَ دَرَجَاتِ الْاَتْقِیَآءِ۔ وَاَلْحَقَكُمَا اللہُ وَاِیَّانَا بِحَقِّكُمَا وَبِاٰبَائِكُمَا الشُّرَفَآءِ مِنَ الاَنْۢبِیَآءِ وَالْاَوْصِیَآءِ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَالصُّلَحَآءِ وَحَسُنَ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ رَفِیْقًا وَلَا خَیَّبَنَا اللہُ مِنْ هٰذِهِ السَّعَادَۃِ وَشَفَاعَۃِ هٰؤُلَآءِ الشُّفَعَآءِ اٰمِیْنَ یَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِیْنَ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمَا وَرَحْمَۃُ اللہِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASH-HADO ANNAKOMA JAAHADTOMA FEE NUSRATE DEENIL LAAHE WA HEMAAYATE I'TRATE RASOOLIL LAAHE HAQQAL JEHAADE FA JAZAAKOMAL LAAHO A'NHO WA A'N NABIYYEHI WA AHLEBAYTEHI WA A'NIL ISLAAME WA AHLEHI AFZALA JAZAAISH SHOHADAAE WA ANMAA HOZUZIS SOA'DAAE WA A'RFA-A DARAJAATIL ATQ'EYAAE. WA ALHAQAKOMAL LAAHO WA IYYAANA BE HAQQEKOMA WA BE AABAAEKOMASH SHORAFAAE MENAL AMBEYAAAE WAL AWSEYAAAE WASH-SHOHADAAAE WAS-SOLAHAAAE WA HASONA OOLAAAEKA RAFEEQAN WA LA KHAYYABANAL LAAHO MIN HAAZEHIS SA-A'ADATE WA SHAFAA-A'TE HAA-OOLAAISH SHOFA AAE AAMEENA YAA RABBAL A'ALAMEENA WAS-SALAAMO A'LAYKOMA WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

trans.en: I bear witness, that you sacrificed to help Allah and to obey His Prophet in the way that sacrifice is to be made, May Allah give reward to you both from Himself and His Prophet and his Ahlul Bait and Islam and from Muslims such a reward that is reserved for Shahids (Martyrs). May He also give rewards reserved for those who do good and elevated positions reserved for the pious. May He also gather both of you and us via your medium and those of your ancestors who are Prophets and martyrs and performers of good deeds and good followers. May Allah not abandon us from this good fortune and recommendation Ameen! Salam from all the worlds on both of you! Allah’s blessings and bounties on you!

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
